example.prompt: A cat playing with a ball

400.description: Bad request. The request is invalid or an invalid API key is provided.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. There are missing fields in the request body.

summary:
Generate a video from a text prompt and optionally an image.
This is an asynchronous operation that returns a request_id for polling.

GenerateVideoRequest.description: Request to generate video for `/v1/videos/generations` endpoint

oneOf.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video.

duration.description:
Video duration in seconds. Range: [1, 15]. Default: 8.
Also accepts `seconds` for OpenAI API compatibility.
Accepts both number (8) and string ("8") values.

oneOf.description:
Optional input image for image-to-video generation.
If provided, generates video with this image as the first frame.
Also accepts `input_reference` for compatibility (same semantics — first frame).
Optional output destination for generated video.

prompt.description:
Prompt for video generation. Required for text-to-video (T2V) and
reference-to-video (R2V). Optional for image-to-video (I2V) — when
omitted, the model generates a video from the image alone.

reference_audios.description:
Optional reference audio clips (voice identity) for reference-to-video
generation. Each entry supplies a clip via `url` or selects a voice via
`voice_id`; caller-supplied clips must be at most 15 seconds long. Only
supported by select video models; at most 3 entries. May be provided
without `reference_images` (audio-only reference-to-video) — at least
one reference of either kind selects the reference-to-video mode.

reference_images.description:
Optional reference images for reference-to-video (R2V) generation.
When provided generates video using these images
as style/content references.

oneOf.description:
Optional output storage configuration. When present, the generated
video is stored in the Files API and a `file_output` reference is
returned in the response alongside the ephemeral URL.

user.description: A unique identifier representing your end-user.

StartDeferredResponse.description: Response for starting a deferred operation.

request_id.description: A unique request ID to poll for the result.

ImageUrl.description:
Image input for generation and editing requests.
Accepts a public URL, a base64-encoded data URL, or a file_id from the xAI Files API.

file_id.description:
File ID from the xAI Files API. Mutually exclusive with `url`.
The file must be an image (JPEG, PNG, or WebP) and fully uploaded.

url.description:
Public URL or base64-encoded data URL of the image (JPEG, PNG, or WebP).
Also accepts `image_url` for compatibility.
Required when `file_id` is not set.

upload_url.description: Signed URL to upload the generated video via HTTP PUT.

AudioUrl.description:
Reference audio input for video generation.
Accepts a caller-supplied clip via `url` or selects a voice via `voice_id`.
Exactly one source must be set.

url.description:
Base64-encoded audio data URL (e.g. `data:audio/wav;base64,...`) or an
http(s) URL to a downloadable audio clip of at most 15 seconds.
Mutually exclusive with `voice_id`.

voice_id.description:
Identifier of a first-party preset voice (e.g. "ara"; same voice
identifiers as the TTS API), resolved server-side to a curated
reference clip from the model's voice-preset catalog. Models configured
for custom voices also accept a custom voice identifier. Mutually
exclusive with `url`.

StorageOptions.description:
Configuration for storing generation output in the Files API.
When provided in a generation request, the output is stored as a
permanent file and a `file_output` reference is included in the response.

expires_after.description:
Seconds from now until the file auto-expires. Maximum 2592000 (30 days).
If omitted, the file does not expire.

oneOf.description:
`true` = create public URL with default options (no independent expiry).
Object = create public URL with explicit configuration.
Omit = no public URL (file stored privately).

PublicUrlInput.description:
Accepts either `true` (create public URL with defaults) or a configuration
object with explicit options.

**Variant order matters for `#[serde(untagged)]`:** `Flag` must come before
`Options` so that JSON `true`/`false` match `Flag` rather than falling
through to the object variant.

**Serialization note:** Proto→REST readback always constructs
`Options(...)`, never `Flag`, so responses always emit the object form.
`Flag` only appears on the deserialization (request) path.

oneOf.description:
`true` = create public URL with default options (no independent expiry).
`false` = no public URL (equivalent to omitting the field).

PublicUrlOptions.description: Configuration for creating a public URL alongside file storage.

expires_after.description:
Seconds from now until the public URL expires. Must be between
3600 (1 hour) and 2592000 (30 days).

If omitted and the file has a TTL (`expires_after` on the file),
the public URL inherits the file's expiry. If omitted and the file
has no TTL, the public URL remains valid indefinitely until the
file is deleted or the URL is explicitly revoked via
`POST /v1/files/{file_id}/public-url/revoke`.
